items.title: Stock Market Today: Dow Ends In Red On Rate Shock Fears; Nvidia Sinks As Anthropic IPO Looms
items.summary: The Dow Jones index falls Wednesday as a Fed official calls for a "shock" in rate hikes to cool inflation. Nvidia ends lower.

items.title: Tech Stocks Boosted by Cybersecurity Rally
items.summary: Plus, Nvidia slips after earnings and a Fed governor pushes for an aggressive hike

items.title: Nvidia highlights open models amid leadership shakeup
items.summary: In its first earnings call since Jensen Huang’s resignation, Nvidia shed light on the growth of open models and the ecosystem it’s helping to build around them.

items.title: AI Risks Lift Cyber Stocks as Software Looks to Shrug Off Slump
items.summary: Cybersecurity stocks rise as software weakness appears to be easing after outages and general tech stock concern has hit the sector.

items.title: Cybersecurity Stocks Shine as Outage Theories Swirl
items.summary: Cybersecurity stocks are rising after a string of recent outages spooked Wall Street and Main Street alike.

items.title: Google Says Fully Autonomous AI Cyberattacks Are Likely Within 6 Months
items.summary: Google is forecasting a wave of machine-run hacking while selling the cure, and Palo Alto reports earnings in the middle of it. Why a stock sliding toward its lows may face its toughest test yet.

items.title: 29 Big Funds Bought CrowdStrike Last Quarter, While 7 Sold. Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAfter adjusting for CrowdStrike’s four-for-one stock split in July, 13 big funds bought the stock in the third quarter and at least 12 sold, according to their 13Fs for the quarter ended Sept. 30.
